name: Snowfall's Mystery
detailed_description:
The main character, a student-programmer named Elliot, has been struggling with mental disorders for a long time. He dreams of one thing – to create a robot assistant that would warm him in the winter of 1999. One day, he receives a floppy disk with a mysterious messenger from his best and, perhaps, only friend. It seems that this program knows more about him than he does, and every conversation with it reveals new aspects of his inner world.

Help Elliot overcome his mental issues and confront his inner demons. Become part of a philosophical journey through the lens of technology and the human psyche.

Key Features:

  • Psychological Narrative – A multitude of secrets hidden in the story that make you reflect on the hero's psyche and the world around him.

  • Interactivity – Instead of just reading text, the game incorporates interactive elements to enrich the experience.

  • Stylistic Design – Minimalistic design using only two colors creates an atmosphere of mystery and tension.

  • Atmosphere – A tense, enigmatic atmosphere that enhances the sense of uncertainty and intrigue.

  • Two Endings – The game offers two different conclusions based on the choices you make.

  • Philosophical and Moral Dilemmas – The game presents choices that challenge you on issues of morality, responsibility, and the nature of humanity.
